Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: What are indefinite and reflexive pronouns? 2. Why do we use indefinite pronouns?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship is promoted as the learner listens to a text on wildlife resources hence caring for others and the environment.

• Critical thinking and problem solving is enhanced as the learner constructs sentences using indefinite and reflexive pronouns.

Values:
Respect is promoted as learners work in groups and respect each other’s opinions while constructing sentences using indefinite

and reflexive pronouns.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Environmental and social issues on animal welfare are promoted as the learner listens to videos on wildlife.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate the use of pronouns to other languages such as Kiswahili.
